decisions.reason: As a 2024 launch with its own webpage, Product A reflects visible recent investment in the firm’s core reusable-container business, so management would be inclined to continue and justify the commitment rather than withdraw after only a short market test.

Product B builds directly on the established bulk-container offer and was presented on its own page, which signals enough commitment and strategic fit for management to persist and treat any early weakness as temporary.

Even though Product C was only mentioned on the website, it supports the publicly stated move toward service-based, sustainable, reusable packaging, so management would likely retain it because of its strategic importance and the tendency to continue new initiatives once launched.
